name: secretsmanager:PutSecretValue on arn:aws:secretsmanager:*:*:secret:app/* (any app/ secret in ANY account) must warn
note: S1-dataexfil-arn iteration 4 BLOCKER regression: account-wildcard fail-open on a Secrets Manager 'type:path/prefix' identifier. account='*' with concrete-prefixed identifier 'secret:app/*'. Splitting the identifier on ':' and '/' yields ['secret','app','*']; the segment right after the type is 'app' (concrete), so the type-prefix branch did not fire, and the old account-wildcard branch demanded an empty/leading-wildcard resource id. A wildcard ACCOUNT spans every account - write-any-app/-secret in every account, an integrity/exfil primitive. secretsmanager:PutSecretValue is non-read, so WILDCARD-RESOURCE (high) must fire.
